description: Source code for network change notifier on macOS/iOS, managing network reachability, connection type detection, and configuration change notifications.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac

methods.description: Returns the current network connection type, waiting up to a timeout if necessary.

methods.description: Initializes the connection type by checking reachability to 0.0.0.0.
